schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE dipendenti (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    data_nascita DATE NOT NULL,
    data_assunzione DATE NOT NULL,
    stipendio NUMERIC(10,2) CHECK (stipendio >= 0),
    manager_id INT REFERENCES dipendenti(id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_dipendenti_manager ON dipendenti(manager_id);

query: WITH RECURSIVE dipendenti_stipendio AS (SELECT id, nome, cognome, stipendio, manager_id FROM dipendenti WHERE stipendio > 0), gerarchia AS (SELECT id AS subordinato_id, manager_id AS manager_id, 1 AS livello FROM dipendenti_stipendio WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT ds.id, g.manager_id, g.livello + 1 FROM dipendenti_stipendio ds JOIN gerarchia g ON ds.manager_id = g.subordinato_id) SELECT m.nome AS manager_nome, m.cognome AS manager_cognome, COUNT(g.subordinato_id) AS totale_sottordinati, SUM(ds.stipendio) AS totale_stipendi_gestiti FROM dipendenti m JOIN gerarchia g ON g.manager_id = m.id JOIN dipendenti_stipendio ds ON ds.id = g.subordinato_id GROUP BY m.nome, m.cognome ORDER BY totale_stipendi_gestiti DESC;
